name: The Rainbird Rehearsal
prompt: Set a civilian sounding rocket on a compact launch stand beside a weather balloon shed. Crews rehearse the water-deluge fountain while observers watch under a covered gallery.

name: The Payload Garden
prompt: Lay out a botanical research launch with seed trays arriving at a clean payload room. Show a sealed specimen cassette being hoisted toward a slender upright rocket.

name: The Retracting Tower
prompt: Show a civilian launch tower folding its access platforms away from a waiting rocket. A cutaway lift cage descends with the last ground crew toward a sheltered stair.

name: The Parachute Loft
prompt: Pair a small research launch pad with an open parachute packing hall. Riggers stretch bright fabric along a table while a recovered capsule arrives on a low trolley.

name: The Weather Window
prompt: Arrange a compact spaceflight pad beside a courtyard of wind socks and balloon reels. A meteorologist releases a striped balloon while the crew wait beside a mobile service tower.
